description: SHA384_STEP: reassociate h-independent adds into balanced IADD3 tree (S1(e)+F0+K+x) — value-identical, selftest PASS but 2886.0 vs 2894.7 baseline (-0.3 pct, within noise band); ptxas already reassociates these integer adds

a3-opt: trim dead final rounds 0x4e/0x4f (only c=digest[2] and d=digest[3] are compared; last 2 steps + their SHA384_EXPANDs only update a,b,e,f which are stored to unread digest[0,1,4,5]). Value-identical, selftest PASS, but 2892.9 vs 2894.7 baseline (-0.06%, within noise) -- ptxas already DCEs the dead tail rounds after inlining

No kernel change. SASS audit of autotuned m10800_s08 (SM86) fully-unrolled 80-round transform: 1594 SHF + 845 LOP3 + 717 IADD3 + 134 IMAD.X(64-bit-add carries) + ~25 IMAD(addressing) + 24 MOV. Ch and Maj each lower to exactly 1 LOP3/word (ptxas fully fuses bitselect), sigmas are funnel-shift XOR3 (minimal SHF), no stray IMAD/MOV in compression. Instruction-selection roofline: work is algorithmically-minimal 64-bit ARX. Confirms 2 prior m10800 discards (reassoc, dead-tail = ptxas) + byte-identical SHA-512 m1700 (reassoc discard, PRMT-offload -2.1%, declared instr-roofline). No untried lever with positive EV.

ncu SpeedOfLight at the REAL autotuned config (optimized kernel m10800_s04, Vec:1/Accel:20/Loops:256/Thr:640 -- NOT the prior forced-vec8 audit): Compute(SM)/ALU=99.0%, Memory=0.14%, Executed IPC=2.08 (== GA10x int32 half-rate ceiling), occ 16% (Block Limit Registers=1, hard-capped by 64-bit ARX reg pressure). Resolves the one memory-flagged open question -- real-width pipe balance MATCHES the vec8 audit (98.9% ALU), so vec8 did NOT overstate ALU headroom for m10800; kernel is a hard integer-throughput roofline, memory is a non-factor. Only lever is cutting dynamic ALU count, all exhausted (Ch/Maj=1 LOP3, sigmas=funnel-shift XOR3, reassoc/dead-tail/round0-IV-const-fold=ptxas no-ops, no CSE-XOR chain to hand-fuse a la Keccak). No untried lever w/ positive EV. (Aside: the a3-PURE kernel is separately DRAM-bw-bound ~779 GB/s, but measure.sh benchmarks the optimized kernel.)

hc_rotr64 (CUDA) confirmed to lower to funnelshift intrinsics -> big/small sigmas already funnel-shift XOR3 (1 LOP3/32b-half, optimal); STEP Ch/Maj=1 LOP3 (bitselect); msg words w7..we are literal 0 -> ptxas const-folds (IV/zero-fold no-op reconfirmed). No untried lever w/ positive EV: reassoc & dead-tail already tried (ptxas no-ops); PRMT byte-rotate offload targets the SHF pipe but bottleneck is the ALU/int pipe (also -2.1pct on byte-identical m1700); register reduction irrelevant since int datapath is throughput-saturated not latency-bound. ncu at real config: 99pct ALU, IPC 2.08 == ~2.0 GA10x 64-bit-int datapath ceiling (FP32-only lanes cannot run 64-bit int ARX, no offload target). Fresh baseline 2893.9 (== 2894.7/2890.8/2893.6 within noise). 3rd principled roofline determination -- 64-bit SHA-2 family at instruction/pipe roofline, stop.
